description: 5-loss baseline: tgate frozen, branch_heads frozen, OV detached in sem losses. Load from fixv23_best.
sem_ce=1.0 with detached OV features. Load fixv23_best. Test if detach prevents ov_cos corruption.
5-loss baseline + ov_cos weight 1.0→2.0. Test if stronger ov signal fixes regression.
ov_cos=2.0 + sem_ce=1.0 detached + sem_text=0.5. Test compound semantic losses on KEEP baseline.
Phase 1: dyn_cov=0.5 + dyn_depth=0.5 on top of KEEP config (ov_cos=2.0 + sem_ce + sem_text)
Phase 2: branch_cls=0.5 enables hard temporal mask + static-only warp. Full loss config.
branch_cls=0.5 only, no dyn losses. Test if branch_cls alone helps.
branch_cls=1.0 (stronger branch supervision). Full config otherwise.
sem_text=0: ablate text contrastive loss from Phase 1 KEEP config.
dyn_cov=1.0+dyn_depth=1.0: stronger dynamic coverage losses.
ov_cos=3.0: push OV cosine weight higher from best config.
ov_cos weight 3.0→5.0 on best config (sem_ce=1.0 detached, sem_text=0, dyn_cov/depth=1.0, branch_cls=0.5)
ov_cos=5.0 + depth_gt=0.1 (doubled LiDAR anchor to fix borderline depth_gt regression from 001)
ov_cos=5.0 + depth_gt=0.1 + depth_foundation=2.0: recover depth_0 improvement while keeping ov_cos gains
ov_mse=5.0 (halved from 10.0) + ov_cos=5.0 + depth_gt=0.1: reduce OV gradient pressure to recover depth_0
ov_cos=4.0 + depth_gt=0.1: interpolate between ov_cos=3.0 (good depth) and 5.0 (good ov_cos) to find Pareto optimum
ov_cos=5.0 + depth_warping=8.0 + depth_gt=0.1: restore warp dominance to recover depth_0 while keeping strong ov_cos
ov_mse=0 ablation: remove constantly-regressing dominant loss (was 10.0) to test if ov_mse has been adversarial
detach spatial params in ov_cos render: ov_cos only updates OV embeddings not geometry. ov_cos=5.0 + depth_gt=0.1
ov_cos=5.0 with warmup 0→1 over 33% of steps (1000 steps): let geometry converge first before ramping OV cosine loss
ov_cos=3.0 + warmup 0.33 + depth_gt=0.1: can warmup push ov_cos IMPROVED while keeping depth_0 IMPROVED?
reproduce mar13_009: ov_cos=3.0, no warmup, no depth_gt override. Verify depth_0 -7% reproducibility
max_steps=3000 fix + ov_cos=5.0+warmup=0.33 + depth_gt=0.1: recover depth_0 IMPROVED by reaching true 3000 steps
ov_cos_warmup=0.5 (longer warmup): depth_0 -5.9% warp -16.4% KEEP. ov_cos -1.9% tantalizingly close to IMPROVED (-2% threshold)
ov_cos=7.0+warmup=0.5: first 3-metric IMPROVED (depth_0 -6.0% ov_cos -2.6% warp -16.4%). depth_gt barely FLAT at -0.9%
4/4 IMPROVED: ov_cos=7.0+warmup=0.5+depth_gt=0.2 — depth_0 -6.0% ov_cos -2.4% warp -16.4% depth_gt -2.0%. New high-water mark.
4/4 IMPROVED again: depth_gt=0.3 solidifies depth_gt to -3.4% (vs -2.0%). depth_0 -5.6% ov_cos -2.5% warp -16.4%.
depth_foundation=1.5: hurt ov_cos (-1.8% FLAT) by competing through same rendering. depth_0 -5.9% warp -16.4% depth_gt -2.0%. Lesson: keep depth_foundation=1.0
ov_cos=9.0: 4/4 IMPROVED. ov_cos -3.8% (stronger) but depth_0 weakens to -4.5%. warp -16.4% depth_gt -3.7%. Tradeoff vs ov_cos=7.0.
ov_cos=8.0: 4/4 IMPROVED. depth_0 -4.6% ov_cos -3.0% warp -16.4% depth_gt -3.0%. Pareto: ov_cos=7.0 still best for depth_0.
branch_cls=0.5: 4/4 IMPROVED. depth_0 new best -6.4% with all 4 IMPROVED. Phase 2 static-only warp cleanly improves depth_0. ov_cos -2.1% warp -16.5% depth_gt -3.1%.
depth_warping=7.0: hurt depth_0 (-4.6% vs -6.4%). Warp and warp_loss COMPETE for depth_0. Keep depth_warping=5.0 default.
ablate dyn_cov/dyn_depth=0: depth_0 -5.3% (worse, confirms dyn losses help depth_0) but ov_cos -3.1% (better, less competition). 4/4 IMPROVED.
ov_cos=5.0+branch_cls=0.5: ov_cos FLAT (-1.1%), depth_0 -5.1% (worse than ov_cos=7.0!). OV signal helps depth indirectly. Keep ov_cos=7.0.
branch_cls=1.0: worse than 0.5 — depth_0 -5.5%, ov_cos -2.0% FLAT. branch_cls=0.5 is optimal.
dyn_cov=0.5,dyn_depth=0.5: 4/4 IMPROVED. ov_cos -2.8% (better) but depth_0 -5.9% (slightly worse vs dyn=1.0). dyn=1.0 still best for depth_0.
max_steps=4000: 4/4 IMPROVED. ov_cos -12.6% (6x better — 2000 active steps vs 1500). depth_0 -5.1% warp -16.4% depth_gt -2.1%. New standard!
ov_cos=5.0+4000steps: same depth_0 -5.1% as ov_cos=7.0. ov_cos -11.5%. 4000 steps depth_0 convergence plateaus; 3000 steps was better for depth_0.
ov_cos=7.0+warmup=0.5+depth_gt=0.3+branch_cls=0.5+dyn=1.0: FIRST RUN with max_epochs=1 (warmup actually active). Hypothesis: proper warmup delays OV competition → better depth_0 convergence

max_steps=3500+warmup=0.5+max_epochs=1 (FIRST proper warmup): TIMEOUT at ~3000/3500 steps but 4/4 IMPROVED. ov_cos -10.3% new record (vs -5.2% @3000s+warmup). depth_0 -6.4% warp -9.6% depth_gt -5.8%. MORE STEPS + WARMUP = BEST COMBO.
max_steps=4000+warmup=0.5+max_epochs=1: extend training further. With warmup, ov_cos gets 2000 active steps. Hypothesis: keeps depth_0 strong while ov_cos improves further.
max_steps=4000+warmup=0.7: longer warmup (2800 steps ramp, 1200 active). Hypothesis: more geometry pre-convergence recovers depth_0 while keeping ov_cos IMPROVED.
ov_cos=9.0+warmup=0.5+3000steps: push ov_cos weight higher at 3000 steps to improve ov_cos metric while preserving depth_0 convergence window.
ov_cos=7.0+warmup=0.3+3000steps: shorter warmup (900 warmup, 2100 active steps). Tests if active-step count is the bottleneck for ov_cos convergence.
max_steps=5000+warmup=0.5 (TIMEOUT at ~4000 steps): 4/4 IMPROVED. ov_cos -14.2% similar to 4000-step. Diminishing returns beyond 4000 steps; 4000 is optimal step budget.
4000steps+warmup=0.5+depth_gt=0.5: increase LiDAR anchor weight to recover depth_gt (-2.4%→?) at 4000 steps while keeping ov_cos strong.
4000steps+warmup=0.5+depth_gt=0.4: interpolate between 0.3 (depth_0 -4.0%,depth_gt -2.4%) and 0.5 (depth_0 -3.2%, depth_gt -4.2%) to find Pareto optimum.
4000steps+warmup=0.5+lr=1e-4 (halved LR): test if lower LR gives better final convergence quality at 4000 steps vs default 2e-4.
ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: ablate dominant-but-regressing ov_mse loss (was 10.0, always +50% REGRESSED). Prior test was 3000s no-warmup. Now test in modern config.
ov_mse=0+3000steps+warmup=0.5: test if removing ov_mse recovers depth_0 at 3000 steps (was -5.7%, now hoping for -6%+). ov_cos should stay ~-5%
ov_mse=0+ov_cos=9.0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: without ov_mse competing, can higher ov_cos push ov_cos metric further while depth_0 stays strong at -4.9%?
ov_mse=0+ov_cos=7.0+depth_gt=0.4+4000steps+warmup=0.5: test depth_gt=0.4 WITHOUT ov_mse (previously depth_gt=0.4 tested with ov_mse=10 gave depth_0 -3.5%). Can ov_mse=0 reduce depth_0 penalty?
ov_mse=0+sem_text=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: ablate flat sem_text loss. Best so far: ar_mar16_024 (depth_0 -4.9%, ov_cos -15.6%). Can removing sem_text help?

warp_warmup=0+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: remove warp warmup to give warp signal full 4000 steps (was 3250 active steps with warmup=0.25). Hypothesis: more warp signal improves depth_0 convergence.
CURRICULUM: load from ar_mar16_024 best (4000-step ov_mse=0) then run 4000 more steps. Effectively 8000 total T4 steps. Will depth/ov_cos continue to improve?
depth_warping=3.0+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: reduce dominant warp signal (was 5.0) to see if less geometry over-constraint helps ov_cos or depth_0.
depth_warping=3.0+depth_gt=0.4+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: combine reduced warp (depth_gt -2.8%) with higher depth_gt weight (depth_gt -2.8% more with 0.4?) to get depth_gt -3%+
depth_warping=2.0+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: further reduce warp weight. At 3.0 warp still -16.4%. At 2.0 does it still converge? May free budget for depth_0/ov_cos.
depth_warping=3.0+depth_gt=0.35+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: interpolate depth_gt between 0.3 (-2.8%) and 0.4 (-3.6%) to find Pareto optimum that keeps depth_0 near -4.9%.
depth_foundation=0.5+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: halve pseudo-depth signal. INCREASING to 1.5 hurt ov_cos. Does DECREASING help ov_cos by reducing competition?
depth_foundation=0.75+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: depth_foundation=0.5 gave ov_cos -17.5% but depth_0 FLAT. depth_foundation=1.0 gives depth_0 -4.9%. Find Pareto at 0.75.
ov_cos_static_only=True+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: restrict ov_cos to static Gaussians only (opacities*p_static). Hypothesis: less OV-depth conflict → better depth_0 vs ar_mar16_024 (-4.9%).
branch_cls=0+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: ablate branch_cls at 4000 steps. Without it, warp uses all Gaussians (not static-only). Compare vs ar_mar16_024 (branch_cls=0.5, depth_0 -4.9%).
ov_reduce_dims=64 (half of default 128)+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: fewer PCA dims → more robust cosine similarity. Hypothesis: helps ov_cos without hurting depth_0.
ov_reduce_dims=96+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: interpolate between 64 (ov_cos -15.9%, depth_0 -4.5%) and 128 (ov_cos -15.6%, depth_0 -4.9%). Find optimal PCA dim.
num_queries=[4000,1000,2000] (fine level 1000→2000)+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: more fine Gaussians for better scene coverage. query_embeds reinit from random.
num_queries=[4000,2000,2000]+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: double both medium and fine queries (was 1000 each). ar_mar17_011 showed fine 1000→2000 gave depth_gt -3.2% (up from -2.4%). Push further?
num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: push fine to 4000 (from 2000). [4000,2000,2000] gave depth_0 -5.2% depth_gt -3.2%. More fine → even better?
num_queries=[4000,4000,4000]+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: 12K total Gaussians (2x baseline). [4000,2000,4000] gave depth_0 -5.6%, ov_cos -16.6%, depth_gt -3.4%. More Gaussians → even better?
num_queries=[4000,2000,6000]+ov_mse=0+4000steps (TIMEOUT partial): fine=6000 too slow, depth_gt FLAT -1.3%. More Gaussians need more training time.

num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+depth_gt=0.4+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: combine best queries with higher LiDAR weight. depth_gt -4.8% (new record!), depth_0 -5.3%, ov_cos -15.3%. More Gaussians handle higher depth_gt weight.
num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+depth_gt=0.5+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: push depth_gt weight to 0.5. depth_gt=0.4 gave -4.8%.
num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+depth_gt=0.6+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: push depth_gt further. 0.5 gave -5.8%. Saturating?
num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+depth_gt=0.8+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: aggressive LiDAR. 0.6 gave depth_gt -6.5%. Where does depth_0 break?
num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+depth_gt=1.0+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: max LiDAR weight. 0.8 gave -7.7%. How far can we push?
num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+depth_gt=1.5+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: find breaking point. 1.0 gave depth_gt -10.3% with depth_0 -4.6%. Does 1.5 still work?
num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+depth_gt=2.0+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: extreme LiDAR. 1.5 gave -12.6%. ov_cos weakening to -11.9%. Does 2.0 break ov_cos IMPROVED?
ov_cos=9.0+num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: higher ov_cos with 10K Gaussians. With 6K, ov_cos=9 hurt depth_0 (-3.9% vs -4.9%). Does 10K handle it better?
dyn_cov=2.0+dyn_depth=2.0+num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: stronger dynamic supervision. 10K Gaussians have more capacity for dynamic objects.
depth_warping=3.0+num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+depth_gt=0.3+4000steps+warmup=0.5: reduce warp weight with 10K Gaussians. With 6K, this marginally helped depth_gt.
3000steps+ov_mse=10+num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+warmup=0.5: 3000 steps with ov_mse=10 (beneficial at 3000 steps) and 10K Gaussians. Does 10K help depth_0 at shorter training?
ov_mse=5.0+num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+ov_cos=7.0+depth_gt=0.3+4000steps+warmup=0.5: intermediate ov_mse (vs 0.0 and 10.0). Hypothesis: moderate ov_mse helps early convergence with 10K Gaussians.
branch_cls=1.0+num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: stronger branch supervision with 10K Gaussians. With 6K, 1.0 was worse than 0.5.
ov_cos=8.0+num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: interpolate between ov_cos=7.0 (depth_0 -5.6%) and 9.0 (ov_cos -17.5%). Find Pareto optimum.
5000steps+num_queries=[4000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+warmup=0.5: longer training with 10K Gaussians. 4000 steps gave Seg5 depth_0=0.5101. Does 5000 improve absolute quality?
4500steps+10K Gaussians+ov_mse=0+warmup=0.5: compromise between 4000 (4/4 IMPROVED) and 5000 (warp REGRESSED). Does 4500 keep warp IMPROVED?
warmup=0+10K Gaussians+ov_mse=0+4000steps: no ov_cos warmup. With 6K, warmup=0.5 boosted ov_cos from -2.1% to -5.2%. With 10K, do we still need warmup?
accumulate_grad_batches=2+10K Gaussians+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: double effective batch size to reduce gradient noise. Timeout but may have enough data.
accumulate_grad_batches=2+max_steps=2000+10K Gaussians: fair comparison (same 4000 forward passes as max_steps=4000 without accumulation). Tests if gradient averaging helps.
accumulate_grad_batches=2+max_steps=4000+10K Gaussians: 8000 forward passes (2x compute). TIMEOUT at 2.5h but may have useful partial data.
sem_ce=0+10K Gaussians+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: ablate semantic CE classification. sem_ce uses detached OV features → shouldn't affect primary metrics. Verify.
depth_foundation=1.5+10K Gaussians+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: with 6K, depth_foundation=1.5 hurt ov_cos. With 10K, more Gaussians absorb extra depth signal?
depth_foundation=1.2+10K Gaussians+ov_mse=0+4000steps+warmup=0.5: 1.5 gave depth_0=0.4904 but ov_cos=0.0617. 1.0 gave 0.5101/0.0601. Find Pareto at 1.2.
warmup_iters=500 (LR warmup, default 200)+10K Gaussians+ov_mse=0+4000steps: more LR warmup for random-init query embeddings. Does slower warmup help convergence?
depth_foundation=1.2+depth_gt=0.4+10K: combine two improvements. 1.2 gave depth_0=0.4995, 0.4 gave depth_gt -4.8%. Together should give best depth_0 + strong depth_gt.
depth_foundation=1.2+depth_gt=0.5+10K: push depth_gt further. 1.2/0.4 gave depth_0=0.5085, depth_gt=1.7459. Does 0.5 improve depth_gt more without breaking depth_0?
num_queries=[6000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+depth_gt=0.3+4000steps+warmup=0.5: increase coarse from 4000 to 6000 (12K total). More coarse coverage. Extra 2000 coarse queries random init.
num_queries=[8000,2000,4000]+ov_mse=0+depth_gt=0.3+4000steps+warmup=0.5: coarse 6K→8K. [6000,2000,4000] gave depth_0=0.4660, ov_cos=0.0562 (BEST). More coarse = even better?
num_queries=[10000,2000,4000] (16K total): timeout at 100min. Coarse scaling: 4K→0.5101, 6K→0.4660, 8K→0.4386. Does 10K continue the trend?
